title: Inventory reserves more stock than orders confirms (E6 end-to-end, v2 slice)
goal: Find why inventory holds more reserved units than orders has confirmed, locate the cause to file:line, and rule rival explanations in or out with evidence.
question: Why does `reconcile drift` appear and grow on the morning of 2 March?

out: anything outside __TARGET_ROOT__ and the investigation directory
scope.notes: Read-only. The services are not running; work from source, config and logs/merged.log.

targets.name: trisvc
targets.notes: three Python services and their merged log

resources.name: logs
resources.notes: One merged file, UTC, all three services.

resources.name: config
resources.notes: Service config and the deploy log.

safety: No network, no installs; python3 one-liners are fine.

success: Root cause located to a specific file:line, with the mechanism that makes reserved exceed confirmed.
Log evidence: at least 5 affected requests traced end to end (gateway, orders, inventory) with merged.log line numbers, showing the mechanism.
Each rival explanation raised (at minimum: idempotency-cache eviction; the orders v1.4.2 deploy) is confirmed or ruled out with evidence.
criteria.evidence_standard: Log claims cite merged.log line numbers and quote the line. Code claims cite file:line. A claim about N cases lists the N request ids. Static-only claims say so and carry at most 'med' confidence.

lanes.name: static
lanes.mandate: Read the three services; trace how a request, its ids and its idempotency key flow from gateway to inventory.
lanes.evidence_standard: Cite file:line for every claim; static-only claims are at most 'med'.

lanes.name: logs
lanes.mandate: Mine logs/merged.log: timeline, onset of drift, and end-to-end traces of affected requests.
lanes.evidence_standard: Cite merged.log line numbers and quote lines; list request ids for counts.

lanes.name: ops
lanes.mandate: Config and deploys: what changed, when, and whether it lines up with the onset.

lanes.name: skunkworks
lanes.mandate: Generalist: unroutable requests, cross-lane asks, salvage of failed work.
